title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Egnyte connector for indexing Egnyte files
summary: The briefing passes: the roadmap facts, licensing, access controls and operational limits are supported. The overview recommends restricted access but does not state a competing default; correct that comparison and clarify the setup route and supporting citations.

claims.claim: Access permissions are reached through Microsoft 365 admin center > Copilot > Connectors > Gallery > Egnyte > Custom setup > Customize user settings > Access permissions.
claims.quote: Select the Connectors tab, and then choose Gallery. ... From the list of available connectors, select Egnyte. ... To customize these values, choose Custom setup. ... Customize user settings ... Access permissions
claims.fix: The cited staged-rollout guide supports going from Copilot > Connectors to Gallery, so the shorter route is supported. claims.where: Why it matters; Open questions: first bullet
claims.claim: The Egnyte deployment and overview pages state different default visibility settings.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Egnyte connector default access permissions quick setup Everyone Only people default'; opened egnyte-deployment and egnyte-overview. Deployment states a default; overview describes both choices and recommends source-restricted access, without specifying a different setup default.
claims.fix: Replace 'The two Learn pages also differ on default visibility (see Data exposure below), which is the point to resolve before the first crawl.' with 'The deployment guide lists tenant-wide visibility by default, while the overview recommends restricting access to people with access to the data source.' Remove the first Open questions bullet; the overview's recommendation does not establish a competing default.
